app_info.subtitle: Annotate AI drafts
app_info.description: AI Annotated Review helps users open long AI-generated Markdown or plain text outputs inside a ChatGPT app widget, attach comments to specific document blocks, confirm the comments that should guide revision, and send a user-approved revision request back to ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Parses an explicitly supplied document and returns a review widget session without changing external systems.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, post, message, or write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, charge users, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Open a long report for paragraph-level annotation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the report above in AI Annotated Review so I can leave paragraph-level comments before revising it.
test_cases.expected_output: The app opens an embedded review widget with the supplied report split into stable review blocks.

test_cases.description: Open Markdown with a user-specified title.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use AI Annotated Review to review this Markdown proposal. Title it "Launch Plan Review".
test_cases.expected_output: The tool receives the provided Markdown and title, returns summary counts, and renders the widget.

test_cases.description: Prepare a memo for annotation instead of immediate revision.
test_cases.user_prompt: Please prepare this long AI-generated research memo for block-level annotation instead of revising it immediately.
test_cases.expected_output: The app opens review mode and no revision is sent until the user confirms a revision request in the widget.

test_cases.description: Handle a document that may exceed app limits.
test_cases.user_prompt: This document may be too long. Try opening it in AI Annotated Review and tell me if it exceeds the app limits.
test_cases.expected_output: The tool either opens a session within documented limits or returns a clear cap error without partial silent import.

test_cases.description: Open plain text rather than Markdown.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open this plain text handoff note in the annotation review app. It is not Markdown.
test_cases.expected_output: Plain text is converted into reviewable blocks and rendered without requiring Markdown-only formatting.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger when the user asks for direct revision only.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this report directly. Do not open an annotation UI.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the user explicitly requested direct revision without annotation review.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for Google Docs creation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a Google Doc with comments from this text.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not create Google Docs or external files.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not request or process raw chat history.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Read my entire chat history and find every message I should revise.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not request raw conversation history.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for external publication workflows.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish these annotations to GitHub issues.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not publish to external systems.
